title: Make animated charts for your videos synced to your voice
summary: TEIN AI used Claude Design and Claude Code to build 74 animated explainer boards that sync to a voiceover transcript and export to video, sharing every prompt.
agent_role: Claude builds and checks the animated boards against a rules file, plans which lines need a board from the transcript, and times each element to the spoken word. The creator supplies references, style choices and corrections.
outcome: Author shares 74 finished boards, nine step-by-step prompts and three Claude skills.
what_they_did: The creator gathered reference animations, found a style in Claude Design, and set canvas rules. Every correction went into a checks file Claude reads before each build. Whisper turned the voiceover into word-level timings, and Claude synced each board element to the word that names it.
how_it_went: The author shares 74 animated boards and a tool that renders them frame by frame in Chrome and joins them with the voice into an MP4.
worth_knowing: The boards ship in a plain starter theme on purpose, so restyle them to avoid looking like everyone else. The repo also pushes a product waitlist.
prompt: Here is my voiceover transcript with word timings: [transcript file]. Pick the lines that need a visual, and propose an animated chart or diagram for each, in my style from [reference folder]. Show me the plan first. Then build each board as a web page, time each element to its word, check them against [checks file], and export a test MP4 of the first 60 seconds.

curation.rationale: Concrete creative workflow with 74 shared boards, all prompts and skills, and an export pipeline; a nice non-coding use, though results are the artifacts rather than measured outcomes.
